caseStudy.title: Houseleek Renhold
caseStudy.lead: A presentation app for a Norwegian cleaning company: every service, from homes and offices to stairs, windows and car care, with photos, a short description and a direct line to book.

brief.title: The brief
text: The company wanted its services in customers' pockets: what it cleans, how it works and how to get in touch, in one simple app.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the app with a service carousel and a page for each service.
Covered home, move-out, furniture and carpets, car care, offices, stairs, windows, gardening and facades.
Put the company's email and phone on every page so customers can book directly.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Customers see every service with photos and a description, and can contact the company from any page.

cta.title: Have a project like this?
